text: {"lessons":["A few quiet months and small fluctuations are not enough reason to trade; I should act only when my view or the portfolio’s needs materially change.","My loss aversion can tempt me to avoid realizing losses, so I should judge each holding by its future prospects and risk—not just its average cost.","Even with a long investing career, diversification and position sizing matter; I should review whether the overall portfolio risk remains appropriate rather than focusing on short-term account movements."]}
